Boots Firedancer, creates workspaces and stacks, and manages child processes with sandboxing and seccomp.

# Purpose
This file implements the `fdctl run` boot path for Firedancer. It checks required permissions and system settings, creates and initializes shared memory workspaces and tile stacks, and starts the validator process tree. The code also handles network namespace setup, XDP file descriptor setup, seccomp policy installation, and privilege drop from root to the user and group from the configuration.

The main control flow builds a parent process, a PID-namespace supervisor, and child processes for `agave` and each Firedancer tile. It uses pipes and `poll()` to detect process death, then stops the full process group if any required process exits with an error. The file also defines the `run` and `run1` actions for the command interface, plus helper functions for workspace path creation, configuration checks, and stack and workspace initialization.
